reviews.review:
Back4Blood is an Action, Zombie, Survival game for both story mode & online co-op. Developed by Turtle Rock Studios, the makers of the legendary zombie franchise Left4Dead and Published by Warner Brothers Games. Being that this game was made by the makers Left4Dead, it had HIGH expectations before it was even released. 2 years later we’re going to see how it held up. With a 6/10 rating on steam and 3.8/5 rating on GameStop, this game left us with a classic arcade type first person Zombie shooter. 

You start the game off by choosing between 1 of 8 characters. Each character has different and unique abilities to help you progress through each act and level. The story mode starts off with you choosing between 4 difficulties.. Recruit, Veteran, Nightmare, and No Hope. For the sake of this review, I was not about to put my sanity on the line doing the story mode in No Hope. If you’re experienced in these types of games, the Veteran, Nightmare, or No Hope difficulty might be your cup of tea. 

The game gave me that nostalgic arcady feeling that comes with games like these. Get rid of Ridden, Take down zombie bosses, save survivors, and escape. But the issue is it’s just that, an arcade zombie shooter, well at least that’s what it felt like. Playing the game as a lone gamer isn’t the funniest option cause recruit is too easy and if you go to any other difficulty it’s too hard to play by yourself, and there isn’t much of a challenge with playing this game by yourself. To be completely honest, It feels like it punishes you for wanting to do so. 

There was very little rhyme or reason behind the game. There isn’t much story to be told with this game but to be honest, it doesn’t need to be one. You’re playing a FPS zombie shooter not a story rich RPG. It does a great job at giving you that classic zombie shooter experience you could imagine all while adding unique features and gameplay elements. Like when you get into each map, you will have Corruption Cards. These Corruption Cards tell you what kid of ridden and hurdles you can expect to see while progressing through each of the maps. Now depending on your difficulty you can get up to 7 Corruption Cards at once maybe even more depending on how far you get with that difficulty. 

As the survivor you will gain access to a Starter Deck that can be customized at your wish. The Started Deck is a customized deck of 15 cards that act as perks to help you progress through each Act. You can’t customize them while you’re in the match so it’s best to know what your going up against before you change them; or change them depending on your play style. I find the Customization of your Story Deck to be unique and entertaining. It gives a fresh perspective on each act and level you enter once you change your deck. All of this combined gives the game a bit of a fun twist to its plot. Sure, it’s your basic zombie shooter, but with the corruption cards, increased player difficulty, and story mode deck, it shines a new light on the game. Of course it’s the same plot but that plot now has a unique twist to it. 

Playing online with this game can be an adrenaline rushing and fun experience when you’re playing with friends. Randoms not so much. If you have a specific objective while playing this game, it’ll be best to play with a group of friends you know rather than randoms. If you’re playing just for fun and laughs, then online is incredible; especially when they have their mics on. But these are just my opinions on the game. Whether you’ve played it or not, I’d love to hear yours.
